prompt: Subject: Afterglow of the Evening Breeze and Blue Sea. Subject: A young adult woman standing with arms crossed in front of her chest on a white sand beach with a blue sea and a breakwater of black rocks in the background. Place the person large in the center of the screen, a waist-up portrait from face to denim shorts, featuring a blue swimsuit, a white wrap, and a woven bag on the left shoulder. Person/Expression: Small oval face, bright smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, glossy coral pink lips. The face is tilted slightly to the left of the screen, looking at the front camera with a quiet expression and the corners of the mouth slightly raised. Thin eyeliner, long eyelashes, pale redness around the eyes and cheeks. Dark brown straight hair almost black to below the chest, long bangs near the center and strands over the face, thin hair crossing to the left of the screen in the sea breeze. Clothing/Pose: Light sky blue triangle bikini swimsuit with fine shirring, thin white shoulder straps. A thin white long-sleeved button-down shirt worn open, sleeves rolled to the elbows and the hem tied lightly below the chest. Faded navy blue distressed denim shorts with the front button and zipper loosely open. An unbleached openwork woven tote bag on the left shoulder. Both forearms crossed horizontally below the chest, holding a white string with the right hand and placing the left hand near the right armpit, standing in front. Background/Light: Foreground to midground is warm-colored white sand with footprints and fine irregularities. Quiet blue sea from the left to the center of the screen, black rock breakwater in front of the horizon, the upper half is a bright blue sky with thin clouds. The low evening sun in the left front directly shines on the face, arms, and abdomen with a warm golden color, illuminating the contours of the hair and white shirt. Shadows are somewhat hard, but the diffused light from the sea and sky keeps the dark areas natural. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Close-up waist-up portrait captured from the front from a horizontal camera at chest height. Leave wide blue sky margins above the head, with the face in the upper half center, crossed arms in the center, abdomen and shorts in the lower half, and thighs cut off at the bottom. Place the horizon line below shoulder height. Focus clearly on the face and costume, with medium depth of field so the sea and rocks are also recognizable. Texture/Style: High-definition photorealistic live-action photo taken in natural evening light. Realistically depict the natural texture of the skin, thin strands of hair in the sea breeze, swimsuit shirring, wrinkles and transparency of white thin cloth, denim fading and fraying, woven bags, sand grains, sea, and rocks. Fresh summer colors of blue, white, and gold, avoiding excessive skin processing or illustration style.
